criteria.name: Contingut i precisió
criteria.description: The video accurately covers the required topic, demonstrates understanding of key concepts, and presents correct information.

levels.label: Excel·lent
levels.description: All key concepts are covered accurately and in depth. No factual errors. Demonstrates excellent command of the subject.

levels.label: Notable
levels.description: Most key concepts are covered correctly. Minor omissions or superficial treatment of some points. No significant errors.

levels.label: Aprovat
levels.description: Core concepts are present but treatment is uneven. Some inaccuracies or gaps in coverage.

levels.label: Suspès
levels.description: Significant gaps or errors in content. Key concepts are missing or incorrectly explained.

levels.label: No presentat
levels.description: No meaningful content related to the topic.

criteria.name: Estructura i claredat
criteria.description: The presentation has a clear introduction, logical development, and a conclusion. Ideas flow coherently.

levels.label: Excel·lent
levels.description: Clear and logical structure with compelling intro, well-organised body, and strong conclusion. Transitions are smooth.

levels.label: Notable
levels.description: Good overall structure. Minor issues with flow or transitions. Intro and conclusion are present.

levels.label: Aprovat
levels.description: Discernible structure but parts feel disjointed or the conclusion is weak.

levels.label: Suspès
levels.description: Poor organisation. Difficult to follow the argument or thread.

levels.label: No presentat
levels.description: No discernible structure.

criteria.name: Expressió oral
criteria.description: Clarity of speech, appropriate pace, vocabulary, and avoidance of filler words or reading verbatim from notes.

levels.label: Excel·lent
levels.description: Confident, clear delivery at an appropriate pace. Rich vocabulary. Minimal filler words. Speaks naturally rather than reading.

levels.label: Notable
levels.description: Generally clear. Occasional hesitation or filler words. Some reliance on notes but not disruptive.

levels.label: Aprovat
levels.description: Understandable but delivery is monotone, too fast/slow, or includes frequent filler words.

levels.label: Suspès
levels.description: Difficult to follow due to delivery issues. Heavy reading from script.

levels.label: No presentat
levels.description: No meaningful audio or completely inaudible.

criteria.name: Anàlisi crítica
criteria.description: Goes beyond description to offer analysis, interpretation, personal reflection, or evaluation of different perspectives.

levels.label: Excel·lent
levels.description: Strong critical analysis. Challenges assumptions, compares perspectives, or draws insightful original conclusions.

levels.label: Notable
levels.description: Some analytical thinking evident. Not purely descriptive. Attempts to evaluate or interpret.

levels.label: Aprovat
levels.description: Mostly descriptive with limited critical engagement.

levels.label: Suspès
levels.description: Purely descriptive. No evidence of analysis or reflection.

levels.label: No presentat
levels.description: No analytical content.

criteria.name: Citacions i referències
criteria.description: Sources are cited verbally or shown on screen. Academic or credible sources are used.

levels.label: Excel·lent
levels.description: Multiple credible sources cited appropriately throughout. References are relevant and support the arguments.

levels.label: Notable
levels.description: Sources are cited. Minor issues with relevance or citation format.

levels.label: Aprovat
levels.description: At least one source cited, or sources visible on screen without verbal citation.

levels.label: Suspès
levels.description: No citations, though content implies external sources were used.

levels.label: No presentat
levels.description: No sources.
